title: keyval.cli.error/v1
description: The envelope a keyval command prints on stdout in --json mode when it cannot produce its normal report: invalid arguments, or a configuration it cannot read (crates/cli/src/output.rs; O-6, §8.7). --json is detected before the arguments are parsed, so even a usage error comes in the format the caller asked for. Exit status 2. The kind enum is open to additions: a reader must treat an unknown kind as an error of unspecified cause (pending and client were added by W33.3; adding a value is not a breaking change).

kind.description: usage: invalid arguments, nothing ran; config: the --config file cannot be read or parsed; pending: the pending store cannot be used or holds no such request; client: the client could not start (no node, no entropy).
